headline: Mineral Resources Shares Testing Support as Volatility Continues - The Bull
summary: Mineral Resources shares fell to A$61.41 before recovering to close at A$65.19, a 1.57% gain, after a 6% intraday swing. The stock has risen 153% over the past twelve months.
why: Mineral Resources is an Australian mining services and lithium-related company listed on the ASX. Its share price is sensitive to commodity cycles and volatility in the mining sector.
